title: Read a story review's diff emphasis and syntax in mounted cases

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-413#mount-story-review-diff-reading

**Verdict: Caught.** At revision `23ac9a5df32995aedb25380b507ca7796a26e354`, the story promises that revealed context stays visible when syntax styling arrives. The maintained mounted Chromium case “styling that arrives after the diff keeps the reading position, revealed context and an open line menu” exercises that transition with the typed `greet.txt` diff and its two file texts. It reveals 20 preceding lines, then adds a TypeScript hint to the same reader.

**Fault.** In the detached scratch worktree, I added `key={syntaxHint}` to `DiffLines` in `dashboard/src/StyledFileDiff.tsx`. This remounts the lines when the hint arrives. The fixtures and maintained assertions stayed intact.

**Evidence.** The focused command exercised exactly one case in each run. The clean baseline passed. The faulted case reached the post-hint assertion for the visible `const` token on new line 28. The captured Chromium screenshot independently shows the syntax-styled hunk directly below the collapsed context control, with the first printed line at 27 and the previously revealed rows gone. The first failing assertion was the post-styling revealed-row count at `dashboard/frontend-tests/review/story-review-diff-syntax-arrival-mounted.spec.ts:80`, with actual 0 and expected 20. I restored the source byte-for-byte, verified the same revision and clean Git status, reran the exact selected case successfully, and removed the scratch worktree.

```sh
caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:dashboard:frontend -- review/story-review-diff-syntax-arrival-mounted.spec.ts --grep 'styling that arrives after the diff keeps the reading position, revealed context and an open line menu' --workers=2
```

The three runs also wrote separate frontend proof records. Logs, proof records, the single-line fault patch, and the captured screenshot are in `/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-741.nIdRk5`.

**Next proof action.** Retain the existing post-styling assertion for this reveal transition.

- **Test runtime:** Measured Vitest runs took 5.72 seconds for baseline, 4.12 seconds with the fault, and 3.87 seconds after restoration, totaling 13.71 seconds. The dashboard runner's elapsed totals for the same three runs were 10.360, 7.993, and 8.027 seconds.
- **Human effort:** Unavailable. No separate effort measure was recorded.
- **Agent effort:** Unavailable. The host did not report active agent time separately from setup and test waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 197746 ms (measured), from 1795191704429 to 1795191902175 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition — checked revision `23ac9a5df32995aedb25380b507ca7796a26e354`, Caught, no follow-up.
